context_requirements: Functional ABCB1/ABCB4 efflux activity for any pharmacological effect
A co-administered ABCB1 substrate whose intracellular concentration is rate-limiting for a transcriptional response
No intrinsic transcriptional program driven by ABCB1/ABCB4 inhibition alone
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple P-glycoprotein inhibitors in the absence of a co-substrate
Evidence that ABCB1 or ABCB4 inhibition directly regulates transcription of a landmark gene
